```{r}
library(targets)
library(tidyverse)
tar_config_set(store="../_targets")
tar_config_set(store="../../../_targets")
```

```{r}
tar_load(predict_soil_combined)

predict_soil_combined %>%
  #filter(model=="plsr") %>%
  group_by(n, k, cluster, model) %>%
  summarize(RMSE=sqrt(mean( (.pred_eoc_tot_c_point - eoc_tot_c)^2)),
            eoc_tot_c = mean(eoc_tot_c)) %>%
  group_by(model, k, n) %>%
  summarize(mean(RMSE), sd(RMSE)/sqrt(n()), mean(eoc_tot_c), n())
```

```{r}
library(lme4)

predict_soil_combined %>%
  filter(model=="plsr", n==3) %>%
  group_by(n, k, cluster, model) %>%
  summarize(RMSE=sqrt(mean( (.pred_eoc_tot_c_point - eoc_tot_c)^2)),
            eoc_tot_c = mean(eoc_tot_c)) %>%
  lmer(RMSE ~ (1|cluster), data=.) %>%
  summary

predict_soil_combined %>%
  filter(model=="plsr", n==3) %>%
  group_by(n, k, cluster, model) %>%
  summarize(RMSE=sqrt(mean( (.pred_eoc_tot_c_point - eoc_tot_c)^2)),
            eoc_tot_c = mean(eoc_tot_c)) %>%
  group_by(k) %>%
  summarize(mean(RMSE), sd(RMSE)/sqrt(n()))
```

```{r}
tar_load(predict_farmlayer_combined)

predict_farmlayer_combined %>%
  group_by(model, n, k) %>%
  mutate(coverage = between(eoc_tot_c, .pred_eoc_tot_c_q025, .pred_eoc_tot_c_q975)) %>%
  summarize(mean(coverage), n())

predict_sitelayer_combined_extra = tar_read(predict_soil_combined) %>%
    inner_join(tar_read(hudson_soils)) %>%
    group_by(group,
           model,
           fit_args,
           n,
           k,
           cluster,
           lay.depth.to.top
  ) %>%
  mutate(se=(.pred_eoc_tot_c_q975 - .pred_eoc_tot_c_q025)/1.96/2) %>%
  summarize(eoc_tot_c = mean(eoc_tot_c),
            # first way
            .pred_eoc_tot_c_se = sqrt(sum(se^2)/n()^2),
            # second way
            #.pred_eoc_tot_c_se = sd(.pred_eoc_tot_c_point)/sqrt(n()),
            .pred_eoc_tot_c_point = mean(.pred_eoc_tot_c_point),
            .pred_eoc_tot_c_q25 = .pred_eoc_tot_c_point - 0.67*.pred_eoc_tot_c_se,
            .pred_eoc_tot_c_q75 = .pred_eoc_tot_c_point + 0.67*.pred_eoc_tot_c_se,
            .pred_eoc_tot_c_q025 = .pred_eoc_tot_c_point - 1.96*.pred_eoc_tot_c_se,
            .pred_eoc_tot_c_q975 = .pred_eoc_tot_c_point + 1.96*.pred_eoc_tot_c_se)  %>% 
  mutate(coverage = between(eoc_tot_c, .pred_eoc_tot_c_q025, .pred_eoc_tot_c_q975)) %>%
  group_by(model, n, k) %>%
  summarize(mean(coverage), n()) %>%
  View



predict_sitelayer_combined %>% View
  #filter(model=="plsr") %>%
  group_by(n, k, cluster, model) %>%
  summarize(RMSE=sqrt(mean( (.pred_eoc_tot_c_point - eoc_tot_c)^2)),
            eoc_tot_c = mean(eoc_tot_c)) %>%
  group_by(model, k, n) %>%
  summarize(mean(RMSE), sd(RMSE)/sqrt(n()), mean(eoc_tot_c), n())
```
